titles.title: Even the Shaman Sister Is New to Incubus
It's the Shaman Noona's First Time With an Incubus, Too
También es la primera vez de la chamana con un íncubo

description:
"You bastard who buried a chicken in my shrine's front yard, come out here." 

Seolhwa is a successful MZ shaman who lines up Cheongdam-dong tycoons. One day, a lustful demon wandered into her shrine, and while she was trying to drive it away by scattering red beans, a glowing tattoo suddenly appeared on the back of her hand—and before she knew it, she had been forcibly made a contract with an ancient demon. Tracing the cause reveals a truly bizarre spectacle. 

At the same time, in the same neighborhood, a ghost hunter YouTuber was attempting a demon summoning ritual to rack up views, a shaman in the same profession was burying a chicken to curse Seolhwa, and a male shaman from the neighboring town was burying venomous snakes and rats for yet another reason. 

Because three malevolent energies collided and entangled simultaneously—the ritual failed, the summoning went awry, and ultimately, only the innocent shaman and the lustful demon were bound by a contract. 

"So, why am I tied to you?"    
"That is the one I want to ask you." 

To break the contract, they need to find the cause, but unfortunately, the culprit—a Ghost Hunter YouTuber—gets carried away by the hype of "Successfully summoning a real demon for the first time on my channel?!" and personally tracks down Seolhwa and the Incubus. 

Lewd Incubus → Cynical Shaman ← Clueless Ghost Hunter. An unbreakable contract, a love triangle that keeps entangled. Even today, Seolhwa's shrine never has a moment of quiet.
